verdict.rationale: Together AI's first-party docs state that supported models can return JSON conforming to any schema you supply, so output can be read directly in code without retries or fragile parsing. Function calling adds structured arguments on top of this. The capability is limited to "supported models", and the evidence never mentions grammar/regex constraints or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: grammar or regex-constrained decoding, a list of which models support schema enforcement, details on strictness guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
